description: Pan Zhang, rough chinese officer in the supplied pixel art style. A dark cloth head wrap with red tails, dark armor with brown fur shoulder pieces, a red skirt with gold trim, dark boots. He holds a thick coiled rope in the right hand
face: A coarse face with a dark moustache.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the dark head wrap with red tails, fur shoulders, dark armor, the red skirt, the coiled rope at his right side.
guard_action: the right hand holds the weapon ready at the side, the left hand comes forward, the knees bend

actions.idle: Guard with a coiled rope hanging from the right hand, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the coiled rope, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b1: Horizontal lash. Frames 1-7 the coiled rope is wound out to the right; frame 9 it is whipped across level; frames 10-11 follow through on the left. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The coiled rope stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b2: Two lashes. Frames 1-6 wind up; frame 7 the first lash; frames 8-10 it swings back round; frame 11 the second lash. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The coiled rope stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a3: Downward lash. Frames 1-7 the coiled rope is swung up over the head; frame 9 it is brought down hard; frames 10-11 hold low. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The coiled rope stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s3: Binding throw. Frames 1-7 the coiled rope is circled once above the head; frame 9 it is cast out forward to bind the target; frames 10-12 he pulls it taut and holds. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The coiled rope stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a2: Rising lash. Frames 1-7 the  trails low behind; frame 9 it is whipped up from below; frames 10-11 it arcs high.
actions.c4: Circling lash. The weapon is swung in one full circle around the body and lashes the target as it comes round to the front; then it is drawn back.
actions.c1: Leaping lash. He springs forward low and fast and lashes the target as he lands; the weapon carries through and is drawn back.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 b1 → b2 → a3, 전법 s3. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
